mapper.sql: count(case when create_time >= #{start} and create_time < #{split} then 1 end) as previousCount, count(case when create_time >= #{split} and create_time <= #{end} then 1 end) as currentCount
mapper.select:
select articles.total as articleCount, articles.previousCount as articlePrevious, articles.currentCount as articleCurrent, articles.views as viewCount, comments.total as commentCount, comments.previousCount as commentPrevious, comments.currentCount as commentCurrent, users.total as userCount, users.previousCount as userPrevious, users.currentCount as userCurrent from ( select count(*) as total, coalesce(sum(view_count), 0) as views,
from b_article where deleted = 0 ) articles cross join ( select count(*) as total, from b_comment where deleted = 0 ) comments cross join ( select count(*) as total, from b_user where del_flag = '0' ) users
select count(1) from b_article where deleted = 0
select count(1) from b_comment where deleted = 0
select count(1) from b_user where del_flag = '0'
select ifnull(sum(view_count), 0) from b_article where deleted = 0

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(1) as count from b_article where deleted = 0 and create_time >= #{start} and create_time <= #{end} group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(1) as count from b_comment where deleted = 0 and create_time >= #{start} and create_time <= #{end} group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(1) as count from b_user where del_flag = '0' and create_time >= #{start} and create_time <= #{end} group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date
